name: Camping 101: Fishing
summary: Someone in Brill believes your fishing skill can help make camp more cheerful. Clyde Kellen can teach you to craft a fishbowl for the camp.

sections.title: A Camp Keepsake
sections.body: Your fishing skill may serve the camp. After proving your skill, you are asked to speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill and learn how to make a fishbowl for the camp. The giver believes that cheerful adventurers fight more strongly, and hopes the fishbowl can bring some joy to you and others.

faq.q: What am I being asked to do?
faq.answer: Prove your fishing skill, then speak with Clyde Kellen in Brill to learn how to make a fishbowl for your camp.
Clyde Kellen is the person in Brill who can teach you to make a fishbowl for your camp.
The fishbowl is a camp item meant to bring joy to you and other adventurers.

faq.q: Why would fishing help the camp?
faq.answer: Your fishing skill can help you make a fishbowl, which the giver hopes will cheer adventurers.

angles.text: As an angler, you can use your fishing skill to make a fishbowl for your camp.
